title: Data-Driven Modeling of a Controlled Orthotropic Plate Using Machine Learning
summary: We study the problem of learning the input-output map of a controlled vibrating plate with a composite structure from experimental measurements. Analytical modeling of this control system faces challenges due to the essential orthotropy and unknown damping characteristics of the material. Surrogate models based on linear regression, multilayer perceptrons, and gated recurrent units are constructed from the available sampled data.
